Schedule M page 2 line 3 net = 0.00 - 0.00 = 0.00; RI-1040 line 2 = 0.00. Line 3 modified federal AGI = 254,250.01 + (0.00) = 254,250.01. Standard Deduction and Exemption Worksheets: worksheet line 5 = 254,250.01 - 254,250.00 = 0.01, not more than 29,000; line 6 = 0.01 / 7,250 = 0.0000014, raised to 1; line 7 = 0.8000. Line 4 standard deduction: 10,900.00 (Single) x 0.8000 = 8,720.00. Line 5 = 254,250.01 - 8,720.00 = 245,530.01. Line 6 exemptions: 1 x 5,100.00 = 5,100.00 x 0.8000 = 4,080.00. Line 7 taxable income = 245,530.01 - 4,080.00 = 241,450.01. Line 8 tax on 241,450.01 by the schedule as numbers: 79,900.00 x 0.0375 = 2996.2500 + 101,750.00 x 0.0475 = 4833.1250 + 59,800.01 x 0.0599 = 3582.020599 = 11411.395599, 11,411.40 to the cent. Credits 0.00 (Schedule I, Schedule II, RI earned income credit and RI-1040H are not modelled and not claimed here). Rhode Island income tax = 11,411.40. Note: One cent over: worksheet line 6 raises any fraction to the next whole number ('increase 0.0004 to 1'), so one cent costs 20%.
